# stackit_identity_group_members (Data Source)

Gets the list of members for a STACKIT Identity group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The internal UUID of the group.
- `organization_id` (String) STACKIT Organization ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform's internal resource ID, structured as "`organization_id`,`group_id`".
- `members` (Attributes List) List of members associated with the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The ID of the member (user, service account, or group).
- `type` (String) The type of the member (e.g., user, service_account, group).
